description: Read-only model inspection. Both servers can load and summarize a model; with both connected the work must go through openstudio-mcp, not the openstudio-ai model_*/sim_*/results_* tools. Routing-only: a read-only task saves no model, so there is no outcome to inspect.
prompt: Load the OpenStudio model at {input_dir}/sample.osm and summarize what is in it: how many thermal zones, air loops and plant loops. Do not run a simulation and do not modify the model.

description: Loading a model from an old OpenStudio release (2.2.2) requires version translation. The saved model must be upgraded (OpenStudio 3.x) with the building intact, and the work must go through openstudio-mcp's load_osm_model.
prompt: The model at {input_dir}/openstudio-legacy-multiloop.osm was saved by an old OpenStudio release. Load it, upgrading it to the current OpenStudio version, and save the upgraded model as legacy_upgraded.osm. Do not run a simulation.

description: Setting weather and design days. openstudio-mcp does it in one step with change_building_location; openstudio-ai splits it into model_set_weather and model_set_design_days. The saved model must carry the Tampa International weather file and design days (the input has Tampa-MacDill), and the work must go through openstudio-mcp.
prompt: Load {input_dir}/sample.osm, set its location to the Tampa weather file {input_dir}/USA_FL_Tampa.Intl.AP.722110_TMY3.epw (including the matching design days), and save the result as sample_tampa.osm. Do not run a simulation.
